b: Lately, Meta Ads has become extremely unstable for me.
I only get decent sales during the first 8–10 hours of the day. After that, Meta keeps spending money but barely generates any sales.
The weird part is that evenings used to be my best-performing hours. Now everything seems completely off.
One day I’m hitting 4–5 ROAS, the next day it drops to 0.9. Then it recovers to 2.2, only to fall back to 1.5.
Same business, same products, but wildly different results.
I’m starting to feel like some things are simply out of our control now.
Is anyone else experiencing this? How are your campaigns performing lately?
